name: Aadhaar Card
description: 12-digit unique identity number issued by UIDAI on behalf of the Government of India, serving as proof of identity and address.
eligibility: Resident of India (stayed for 182 days or more in the past 12 months), NRI holding valid Indian Passport.
requiredDocuments: Proof of Identity (e.g., Passport, PAN Card, Voter ID)
Proof of Address (e.g., Passport, Utility Bill, Bank Statement)
Proof of Date of Birth (e.g., Birth Certificate, SSLC Certificate)
Passport-size Photograph (taken at enrolment center)
steps: Locate nearest Aadhaar Enrolment Centre online.
Fill out the enrolment form (available at center or downloadable online).
Submit enrolment form along with PoI, PoA, and PoDB documents.
Provide demographic and biometric data (fingerprints, iris scan, photo).
Collect acknowledgement slip containing 14-digit Enrolment ID (EID).
Track status online and download e-Aadhaar once generated.
importantNotes: Aadhaar is a proof of identity, not proof of citizenship. Basic enrolment is free of cost.

name: PAN Card
description: Permanent Account Number (PAN) is a 10-digit alphanumeric identifier issued by the Income Tax Department for financial & tax tracking.
eligibility: Any individual, minor (via parent/guardian), company, trust, or non-resident Indian earning taxable income.
requiredDocuments: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Passport)
Proof of Address (Aadhaar Card, Utility Bill, Bank Passbook)
Proof of Date of Birth (Aadhaar Card, Birth Certificate, Matriculation Cert)
Two Recent Passport-size Photographs
steps: Visit NSDL / Protean or UTIITSL official portal.
Select Form 49A (for Indian Citizens) or instant e-PAN using Aadhaar e-KYC.
Fill in personal details accurately matching proof documents.
Upload scanned copies of photograph, signature, and proof documents.
Pay application fee online.
Download instant e-PAN or await physical PAN card delivery by mail.
importantNotes: Linking PAN with Aadhaar is mandatory as per Income Tax regulations.

name: Driving Licence
description: Official document authorizing an individual to drive a motor vehicle on public roads, issued by State Regional Transport Offices (RTO).
eligibility: Age 16+ for gearless 50cc 2-wheelers; Age 18+ for light motor vehicles (LMV); Learner's Licence held for minimum 30 days.
requiredDocuments: Valid Learner's Licence Number
Proof of Age (Aadhaar Card, Birth Certificate, Passport)
Proof of Address (Aadhaar Card, Ration Card, Rent Agreement)
Form 1 (Self-declaration of physical fitness) / Form 1A (Medical Cert for 40+)
Passport-size Photographs
steps: Apply and obtain Learner's Licence (LL) via Parivahan Sewa portal.
Hold LL for minimum 30 days (and maximum 180 days).
Book a slot for practical driving test on Parivahan portal.
Appear at designated RTO with vehicle and original documents.
Pass the practical driving skill test conducted by RTO inspector.
Receive physical Smart Card Driving Licence by post.
importantNotes: Driving without a valid licence is a punishable offence under the Motor Vehicles Act.

name: Indian Passport
description: Official travel document issued by the Ministry of External Affairs establishing identity and nationality for international travel.
eligibility: All Indian citizens by birth, descent, or naturalization with no active criminal convictions or flight bans.
requiredDocuments: Proof of Present Address (Aadhaar Card, Utility Bill, Bank Passbook)
Proof of Date of Birth (Aadhaar Card, Birth Certificate, Transfer Certificate)
Non-ECR (Emigration Check Not Required) Proof (10th/12th Pass Certificate or Higher Degree)
steps: Register and log in to Passport Seva Portal (passportindia.gov.in).
Fill application form online (Fresh Passport / Re-issue).
Pay fee online and schedule appointment at nearest Passport Seva Kendra (PSK).
Visit PSK on scheduled date with original documents for document verification and biometrics.
Complete police verification procedure at local police station.
Receive Passport via Speed Post.
importantNotes: Ensure document details (name, DOB, parent names) match strictly across all submitted proofs.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
description: Financial assistance program for eligible school and college students to pursue higher education without financial barriers.
eligibility: Students enrolled in post-matriculation courses, annual family income <= ₹2,500,000, valid category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/General Merit as applicable).
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card linked with Bank Account
Current Academic Fee Receipt & Student ID
Marksheet of previous qualifying exam
Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority (Tehsildar)
Domicile Certificate / Caste Certificate (if applicable)
Bank Account Passbook Copy
steps: Register on National Scholarship Portal (NSP) or State Scholarship Portal.
Complete e-KYC using Aadhaar.
Select Scheme: Post-Matric Scholarship.
Fill educational details, family income, and bank account details.
Upload required scanned documents.
Submit application and submit physical copy to institute verification officer.
importantNotes: Scholarship funds are directly transferred via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi & Welfare Scheme
description: Central sector welfare scheme providing financial benefit to eligible landholding farmer families across India.
eligibility: Small & marginal farmer families owning cultivable land; annual family income criteria applies; institutional landholders excluded.
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card
Land Ownership Documents (Khatauni / Land record passbook)
Aadhaar-linked Active Bank Account
Mobile Number linked to Aadhaar
steps: Visit PM Kisan portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or local Common Service Centre (CSC).
Click 'New Farmer Registration'.
Enter Aadhaar number and state details.
Fill land record details and bank details.
Complete e-KYC via OTP or biometric CSC verification.
Status is verified by District Nodal Officer before disbursement.
importantNotes: Mandatory e-KYC and land seeding are required to receive installment disbursements.
